ns2:section.sectionText: This course guides first-year engineering students to maximize their time in the Grainger College of Engineering through application/implementation of design thinking processes. Through active learning, reflection, and creative thinking students will prototype multiple potential Illinois experiences. Topics include understanding your purpose in college, finding your way through the many opportunities offered in the Grainger College of Engineering, what to do when you ‘get stuck,’ and how to tell your college and career-prep story. Restriction: Instructor Approval Required
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to Academic Bridge Participant students.
